title: CLI Serve Guard Entrypoint Invariant Verification & Bypasses Elimination
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries-cli.ts (211 LOC) and runner-verify.ts (112 LOC); empirically verified by 11 tests in r3-counterexamples.test.ts and 17 regression tests in architecture-boundaries-regressions.test.ts.
resolution: Resolved. auditCliServeEntrypoint now enforces: 1) AST CallExpression inspection for dynamic import; 2) tracking imported bindings and local declaration shadowing; 3) strict binary equality checking on condition (=== 'serve'); 4) exact package specifier resolution preventing blind fake-package substitutions; 5) non-recursive invocation scanning that ignores uninvoked nested function declarations; 6) AST export verification ensuring the target runner file exports a callable main function.
